==Biography==
===Season 3===
During season 3 Jockster was a jungler for many amateur teams like [[Lemon Gaming]]  and [[Animaniacs]], starting his Pro career on [[RMA e-Sports]] but the team was quickly disbanded and picked up by the [[Acezone]] organization in order to participate in the BGL tournaments. After a couple months in the [[Acezone]] organization the roster was picked by the [[PeesPlay Gaming]] organization but did not find success in the [[Riot Season 3 Brazilian Championship]] and also disbanded.
After spending some time in mid lane for the [[Action Team]] Jockster was hired as the jungler for the [[Cyber Gamer E-Sports]]  team, but the team was unable to win tournaments and the organization lost many players, which led into the team disband.

===2014 Season===
Jockster was invited to join [[Team United]] where he played alongside his friend [[MicaO]] in the [[Riot Brazilian Champion League 2014]] but  the team was only able to achieve the 6th place. After the end of the tournament, he and the rest of the team left the [[Team United]] organization in order to form the team [[Out of Position]], where Jockster was placed as a support after [[Djokovic]] stepped up as the new jungler. Briefly after the roster change the team was signed by [[INTZ e-Sports]].
[[INTZ]] quickly  became one of the best Brazillian teams and won major tournaments  like [[Circuito Game7]] without losing a single game, with the bot lane made of [[MicaO]] and [[Jockster]] growing into a bot lane that was very respected on the scene.
===2015 Season=== 
In the [[INTZ]] dominance over the [[CBLOL/2015 Season/Split 1|CBLOL 2015 Split 1 Split]], he became one of the best supports in the Brazillian scene, pulling out bans against his {{ci|Veigar}} and providing vital peel for [[MicaO]].
After [[Revolta]] left the team to join [[Keyd Stars]], Jockster moved back to jungler, while [[Alocs]] joined the team. After getting second place in [[CBLOL/2015 Season/Split 2 Playoffs|CBLOL Split 2 2015]], INTZ announced Revolta's return, and the acquisition of [[Loop (Caio Almeida)|Loop]] to the support role. Instead of leaving INTZ for a starting position in other teams, Jockster decided to stay with INTZ as a substitute.<ref>[https://www.facebook.com/INTZeSports/photos/a.306179849545974.1073741828.298133647017261/492331024264188/ INTZ's Facebook Post (Portuguese)] ''facebook.com''</ref>
===2016 Season===
In 2016 he was part of the lineup that is often referred as the Exodia of CBLOL: [[Yang (Felipe Zhao)|Yang]], [[Revolta]], [[tockers]], [[micaO]] and [[Jockster]], led by [[Peter Dun]] and [[Abaxial]]. The team managed to never lose a series that they played on Brazilian soil. They played at [[CBLOL 2016 Split 1]] and consequently won [[CBLOL 2016 Split 1 Playoffs]] after beating [[Keyd Stars]] for 3x0 in the Grand Finals. With the win, they classified [[INTZ]] to the [[2016 International Wildcard Invitational]], where they managed to achieve 3rd place among other Wildcards regions.
In the [[CBLOL 2016 Split 2|second split]], they found theyselves in a rivalry against [[CNB e-Sports Club]] until they beated them by 3-1 in the [[CBLOL 2016 Split 2 Playoffs|finals]]. In the [[IWCQ 2016]], they managed to classify to [[Worlds 2016]], where they made history by being the only Brazilian team to defeat an Asian team from a Major league by defeating [[EDward Gaming]], despite not qualifying for the main stage of the tournament.<ref>[https://www.espn.com.br/esports/artigo/_/id/5732003/adeus-exodia-o-fim-e-o-legado-do-quinteto-mais-vitorioso-do-cblol Adeus, Exodia: o fim e o legado do quinteto mais vitorioso do CBLoL]''espn.com.br''</ref>

== Trivia ==
* Spends a lot of time playing and streaming with [[MicaO]].
* His smurf is named “Jocksterisacat” while his longtime friend and lane partner [[MicaO]] have a smurf named “Micaoisadog”.
* Was very sad due to the {{ci|Veigar}} changes on Patch 5.4.
* After playing competitively as jungler and support, joined [[INTZ Red]] as top laner.
* Portrayed as {{ci|Rek'Sai}} in the CBLoL 2015 official wallpaper.
* He is known for his aggressive playstyle and getting lots of kills as a support.
* In his prime, he was known by his {{ci|alistar}}.
* There's a running gag about '''Jockster''' frequently stealing pentakills from his AD carry. When interviewed about it, he said "as long as I'm alive, no one in my team is getting a pentakill".
* He says his favorite role in the game is jungler, but that he's more skilled as a support.
* During one of the games he played for [[Vivo Keyd]] in the [[CBLOL 2018 Split 1 Playoffs]] against [[RED Canids]], a voice comms video revealed he screamed "Os dois coreanos não sabem jogar" (The two koreans don't know how to play) at the opposing team, refering to [[Winged]] and [[Sky (Kim Ha-neul)|Sky]], after he got them both killed in a gank in the midlane. The audio afterwards became a meme in the community, often used to refer when korean players in Brazil play badly or below expectancy.<ref>[https://youtu.be/CwTkluxpZ6A?si=nMFP0x8sDqf9bpRZ Jockster - os dois coreanos não sabe jogar velho] ''youtube.com''</ref>
